===Lobby===
[[Petrified Pete]] guards the mine entrance. There is a [[Fossil Storage]] for players to store fossils obtained in the mine and a [[bank chest]] which players can use to prepare and bank rewards. The bank chest is also very close to the [[volcanic mine teleport]] location, but due to the point cost of the tablet, it's recommended to use a different bank if simply looking for [[Fastest bank teleports|one close to a teleport]].
